Proposed next steps:
1) You send the attendee passport details (as above) by Mon 4/5.
2) We generate signed invitation + embassy support packet and route to GlobalExec.
3) GlobalExec attempts to secure earliest available consulate appointment; they will share cost and slots.

If you prefer we also include a short cover note from your legal team, send that and we'll prepend it to the packet.

Thanks —

From: Brazil Consulate Sao Paulo <visa@consulate.br>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mariana Silva <mariana@tecnologica.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:57:00 -0300
Subject: Required documentation for business visa applications (Sao Paulo Consulate)

Dear Ms. Cole and Ms. Silva,

Thank you for contacting the Consulate. For business visa applications related to a corporate event in Sao Paulo, please submit the following:

1) Passport (valid minimum 6 months beyond planned exit from Brazil)
2) Two passport photos (3.5x4.5 cm)
3) Completed online application confirmation page
4) Original invitation letter from host (signed and on company letterhead)
5) Proof of accommodation and round-trip ticket reservation
6) If applicable, letter from employer stating purpose of travel and who is covering expenses

Expedited appointments are considered on a case-by-case basis. To support a priority request, include a scanned copy of the invitation letter and an explanatory support letter (we recommend the host include precise event dates and a short paragraph on business necessity).

Processing times:
- Standard: up to 15 business days (can increase during peak season)
- Expedited: typically 5–8 business days if a priority appointment is granted

Please note: documents submitted electronically do not guarantee a priority slot. The Consulate reserves the right to request in-person interviews.

Sincerely,
Consular Section
Embassy of Brazil — Sao Paulo
visa@consulate.br
--
(automated signature; not a substitute for formal appointment notification)
